name: Kanojo no Seiiki
source:
One day, our hero is headed home from Akihabara when he's mistaken for a molester. The person accusing him is his childhood friend, Akiyoshi Fuyuka. When they were both children, she was a well-dressed and lovely young rich girl, and the idol of the class. She was the apple of every boy's eye, but it was impossible to get close to her, our hero included. But our hero was in love with her. He has memories of when he was younger and first felt that way.

Before long, they ended up parting ways due to going to different middle schools. Our hero thinks that she might have been his first love. He didn't actually molest her, but all she will say to him is: "If you want me to forgive you, then become my butler!" These two recently reunited people end up in an unusual relationship as their unusual story begins once again...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1961760/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
某天，我们的主人公从秋叶原回家时，被误认成了痴汉。指认他的人是青梅竹马秋吉冬香。小时候，她是一个衣着讲究、可爱漂亮的富家千金，也是班级偶像。她是所有男孩心中的女神，包括主人公在内都难以接近她。但主人公一直爱着她，也记得自己年幼时第一次产生这种感情的时刻。

不久后，两人因升入不同的初中而分开。主人公觉得，她或许是自己的初恋。他明明没有猥亵她，但她只对他说：“想让我原谅你，就来当我的管家！”这对久别重逢的人，就这样陷入了奇妙的关系，非同寻常的故事再次开始……

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1961760/]Steam[/url]]
